analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($0.94) vs SMA5 ($0.93)/SMA20 ($1.03)/SMA50 ($1.21) - Above short-term SMA5, below mid-term SMA20/50, in bearish territory.
· Position vs SMA100 ($1.30)/SMA200 ($1.24) - Maintaining strong bearish mid-to-long-term trend.
· 52-week position (4.9%) + Current price near 52-week low ($0.87), testing support.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (31.1→32.1) + Entering oversold + Attempting bearish bounce.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0008→0.0008) + Improving diagnosis + No confirmation of bearish trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $0.82) + Bandwidth at 41.82% indicates high volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($0.89) + Basis (5-day low, Bollinger lower band).
· Swing resistance ($1.13) + Potential for mid-term trend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower Low) + Signal of continued downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.49x) + Increased confidence in movement, reinforcing downtrend.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + Consider buying after recovery above 20-day low and breaking above RSI 45.
